==Description==
'''Parrot Party''' was an [[Emotes|emote]] that could have been bought in the store for {{Coins|800}}. It was made by [https://www.roblox.com/users/109517370/profile MRePotatoes]. The emote was looped and no music could be heard while performing the emote. You could not move while performing this emote.

==Trivia==
*This [[Emotes|emote]] was based on [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S_gnnnAEcso parrots dancing] when they are near a [https://minecraft.wiki/w/Jukebox Jukebox] playing music in ''Minecraft''.
*This emote, alongside [[Poisoned]], was removed in the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]].
**However, both of these emotes were added back nearly 4 years later in the [[v1.34.0|Stickers Update]]. However, [[Poisoned]] would break shortly after its addition, while '''Parrot Party''' has never worked.
